description: This file contains unit tests for the ExecApprovalsSocketPathGuard functionality, specifically testing directory permission setup, and rejection of symlink and file-type socket paths.

methods.name: harden parent directory creates directory with0700 permissions
methods.description: Tests that the parent directory created by the guard has 0700 POSIX permissions.

methods.name: remove existing socket rejects symlink path
methods.description: Tests that attempting to remove a socket at a symlink path raises the appropriate error.

methods.name: remove existing socket rejects regular file path
methods.description: Tests that attempting to remove a socket at a regular file path raises the appropriate error.
